title: Startup and host integration
invariant: Follow the host boundary: workspace identity scopes the mounted runtime; native panel navigation and DOM stay inside its host.

title: Project schema and persistence
invariant: Trace draft, published state and revision checks before changing persistence; preserve portable IDs and migrations.

title: Editor coordination
invariant: Keep mode coordination separate from domain edits, history, persistence and presentation; Apply is the publication boundary.

title: Construct and floor topology
invariant: Start at topology and validation for architectural changes: walls own openings; junctions and derived collision must agree.

title: Arrange and placement
invariant: Resolve catalog definitions and supported placement before changing item records; preserve floor and item identity through history.

title: Connect and binding profiles
invariant: Keep local slot declarations separate from browser household mappings; matching and rescan remain read-only.

title: Home Assistant runtime and controls
invariant: Resolve and authorize supported controls at runtime; credentials and household IDs stay outside generated home source.

title: Dashboard, navigation and cameras
invariant: Room selection glides to a consistent angle fitted beside controls; manual navigation interrupts, reduced motion settles immediately, and overview restores the default floor framing. The combined floor summary expands floor pills that update the active floor and room list. Keep floor switching and walk state coherent; missing runtime data must leave a usable scene.

title: Scene geometry and rendering
invariant: Trace derived geometry and collision from floor architecture; visible geometry uses procedural toon rendering. Active-floor emitters retain zero-intensity lights across state changes to avoid shader recompilation. Room emphasis updates floor materials and wall vertex colors without rebuilding geometry or changing device lights.

title: Catalog and model extensions
invariant: Inspect stable registries first; supported catalog subpaths are the consumer boundary and home extensions own bespoke geometry.

title: Optional walk tools
invariant: Register optional tools in the web host; injected navigation, activation and storage keep HA access inside the engine. Prepare and retain shot shader programs on equip to avoid trigger-time compilation. The gun owns its first-use tutorial and browser-local dismissal.

title: Bundled home and agent generation
invariant: Author one accepted layout or room stage at a time in home/; browser edits do not rewrite the bundled seed. Follow the generation skill review gates.

title: Verification and delivery
invariant: Use verify:help to select iteration checks; unknown or shared impact requires the complete verify gate, as does shared product delivery. Fixture/build success does not establish household, deployment or cross-browser acceptance.

title: Shortcuts and private HA actions
invariant: Keep shortcut order and kinds portable; scene/script entity IDs belong to origin-scoped draft/published binding profiles. Save publishes both atomically. Activation uses guarded one-shot commands, never toggles.
